hypotheses.G0_pair_interactions_are_material: Adding the two discovery-ranked degree-two layer interactions to the degree-at-most-one program improves fidelity by at least 0.03 on every corpus.
hypotheses.G1_pair_identity_beats_random_median: The same two interactions beat the median matched random pair by at least 0.01 on every corpus.
hypotheses.G2_pair_identity_beats_random_p95: The same two interactions beat the matched random-pair 95th percentile on every corpus.
hypotheses.G3_pair_ranking_transfers: The discovery top-two pair set overlaps the independently ranked top-two pair set on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.G4_half_gain_is_first_order_compact: At bilinear derivative gain 0.5, five or fewer frozen groups reach 90% fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.G5_native_gain_needs_more_than_first_ord: At native gain 1.0, more than five groups are required for 90% fidelity on at least one corpus.
hypotheses.G6_high_gain_broadens_the_program: At gain 2.0, the K90 path count exceeds its native-gain value on every corpus.
hypotheses.G7_effective_support_grows_with_gain: The energy-based effective support of the 16 group paths increases monotonically from gain 0.5 to 2.0 on every corpus.
